releaseNotes:
• App Limit Bypass Fix: Re-launching, home-press, app-switching, notification taps, or rapid launcher taps now immediately displace blocked apps back to Home and surface BlockingActivity reliably
• Monotonic Accounting: Sub-minute accounting tracks exact elapsed seconds without loss
• Enforcement State Machine: Formal EnforcementState (UNDER_LIMIT, LIMIT_REACHED, TEMPORARY_BYPASS_ACTIVE, DAILY_RESET_PENDING) integrated into QuotaEngine
• Automatic Local Midnight Rollover: Background date monitor checks local calendar date every 5s, resetting quotas seamlessly at 00:00 without app restart
• Tamper-Proof Time Changes: Clock manipulation or timezone changes no longer unblock exhausted app quotas; blocked package caches remain intact
• Midnight Rollover UI: BlockingActivity automatically restores access past midnight with an interactive Open App action
